annotations.title: Submit a strategy to the desk lab

description: Submit a desk-engine strategy spec for paper testing. It is validated fail-closed (known features and ops only, a stop loss, bounded sizing), then authored on YOUR account: a priced scripted skill carrying the pinned spec, a rig that trades your own Signet paper ledger desk-<id> on real quotes, and a 5-minute schedule. Answers {id, ledger, rig_id, skill_listing_id, schedule_id, status:'trial', submitted:true}; a spec that is 'none' or does not validate answers {submitted:false, reason} (not an error). Paper only — no money moves. Signed-in; open to the founder's account unless the lab is opened.

hypothesis.description: What this arm tests, in one or two sentences (≤600).

spec.description: The strategy spec: a JSON object, or JSON text (a model step's response, fences allowed). 'none' submits nothing.
